svg.title: AXIS — Star | From Classical Form to Cosmic Execution
svg.desc: AXIS Observatory exhibition header featuring the forged Axis emblem, Florentine classical proportion lines, and cosmic coordinates.

g.text: From classical form to cosmic execution.
从古典艺术到宇宙星辰，从思考到实现
把思考锻造成可核验的系统与视觉体验。
独立开发者 Star，聚焦 Agent 运行时可靠性、Harness 工程、受控 Skill 演化与 WebGL 视觉表达。
